name: @wirecat/notion-cli
description: Notion pages and databases for you and your AI agent: read live with your own token, through the terminal or MCP
author: Viacheslav Ptsarev

scripts.build: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/from-config.ts --if-missing && tsc --build --force && cli-dev bundle --bin dist/bin/notion.js
scripts.typecheck: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/from-config.ts --if-missing && tsc --build --force --emitDeclarationOnly && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:matrix: vitest run >/dev/null && pnpm build >/dev/null && pnpm test:matrix:check
scripts.test:matrix:check: cli-dev test-matrix --program scripts/command-program.ts --untested scripts/test-matrix-untested.ts --name notion --check && git diff --exit-code -- docs/dev/test-matrix.md
scripts.generate: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/from-config.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/generate.ts && pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/commands.ts && cli-dev manifest --program dist/program.js --identity dist/wcat.js
scripts.generate:check: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/from-config.ts --check && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/generate.ts --check && pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/commands.ts --check && cli-dev manifest --program dist/program.js --identity dist/wcat.js --check
scripts.smoke:bun: bun scripts/smoke.ts && bun scripts/sandboxed.ts bun scripts/smoke-bundle.ts
scripts.docs:check: cli-dev docs-check --rules scripts/docs-rules.ts --pages && cli-dev changelog fragments && pnpm docs:spell && rumdl check --config config/wirecat/rumdl.toml README.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md docs/*.md docs/dev/*.md && pnpm docs:lint
scripts.contracts:check: cli-contract contracts/plan.json && cli-dev manifest --program dist/program.js --identity dist/wcat.js --check
scripts.lint:commands: pnpm build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/sandboxed.ts cli-dev lint --cli dist/bin/notion.js
scripts.release:check: pnpm standards:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm lint:commands && pnpm audit:commands && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm test:matrix:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm generate:check && pnpm version:check && pnpm security:no-leak && pnpm package:check
scripts.docs:spell: cspell lint --config cspell.json --no-progress --no-summary README.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md 'docs/*.md' 'skills/**/*.md'
